annotations.title: His brother shal take her.
annotations.text: This proueth euidently that the prohibition, not to marie the brothers wife (Leuit. 18.) was a positiue law, binding only when the first brother dying left issue. [1] For dying without issue, his brother was bound by this law to marie the widow. In default of the brother, the next of kinne was to marie her: and for default of neerer, the more remote. so Booz maried Ruth. [2]Neither was it contrarie, but agreable to the law of nature, to marie the brothers wife when he was dead without issue, as is before noted. Gen. 38.

notes.text: Mariage with the brothers wife, he dying without issue.
